name: DiffCSP
org: Tsinghua University, Renmin University of China
one_liner: Jointly diffuses unit-cell lattice matrices and fractional atomic coordinates under periodic E(3)-equivariant symmetry constraints.

loop.proposes: A periodic E(3)-equivariant denoising network jointly updates lattice vectors and fractional coordinates from a target composition.
loop.judged_by: Periodic crystal geometry validators, RMSD matchers, and DFT energy evaluations score the generated polymorphs.
loop.steers: Space-group symmetry constraints and multi-sample energy ranking select the lowest-energy valid crystal structure.

headline_result: Outperformed USPEX evolutionary crystal search and CDVAE on MP-20 and Perov-5 crystal structure prediction at a fraction of the compute time.
caveat: Requires specifying the target unit-cell stoichiometry upfront unless paired with a composition generator.
beyond_harness_note: Uses a periodic E(3)-equivariant diffusion model over fractional coordinates and lattice matrices, ranked by physical energy.
algorithmic_authority: Space-group symmetry validator and DFT energy evaluator

sources.title: Crystal Structure Prediction by Joint Equivariant Diffusion (NeurIPS 2023 / arXiv:2309.04475)

verification.notes: Checked against Jiao et al., NeurIPS 2023.
